name: std::ranges::subrange<I,S,K>::prev

declarations.code:
constexpr subrange prev(std::iter_difference_t<I> n = 1) const

    requires std::bidirectional_iterator<I>;

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
n

 -

 number of decrements of the iterator

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The difference between this function and advance() is that the latter performs the decrement (or increment) in place.

summary: Returns a copy of *this whose begin_ is decremented (or incremented if n is negative). The actual decrement (or increment) operation is performed by advance().
